name: arcade-char_elf-armored-task51
prompt: A full-body, high-detail depiction of a slim elf ranger standing in a heroic, grounded stance. The character wears an intricate layer of dark green hooded cloak over ornate gothic plate armor, featuring a polished steel breastplate adorned with delicate, deep-etched filigree. The armor includes rounded, riveted pauldrons, articulated steel gauntlets, and matching greaves, all layered over a worn brown leather base. A vivid crimson cloth tabard with ornate gold trim is draped across the torso, secured at the waist. A small, elegant recurve bow is strapped to the back. The face is uncovered, displaying sharp, alert features and pointed ears. The composition utilizes high-contrast shading and subtle rim lighting to define the metallic textures of the steel, with selective, crisp dark outlines to ensure clarity, rendered in a 3/4 low top-down perspective.
